title: 第17章 他不犯贱第18章 托他办件事
content_zh:
回家的路上，特意去了一趟书店，按照苏夫子开的书单，买了几本书，花费十三两银子。
这年头，书籍太贵，读书过分昂贵，甚至谈得上奢侈。
当年大姐陈小兰在婆家讨生活，还坚持送他上私塾，其中心酸委屈难以言表。再一次意识到自己亏欠大姐太多。
他干脆又买了一套首饰，金耳环，金手镯，金项链，金戒指。另外买了几斤猪头肉，提着一壶酒上苏家。
酒肉给了苏老婆子。
苏老婆子原本拉长的脸，罕见的有了笑容，还留他吃晚饭。
他肯定不吃。
他要是吃了晚饭，苏老婆子又得唠叨好几天，大姐耳边不得清闲。
陈小兰却不赞同。
姐弟俩私下里说话，“你买的酒菜，就该留下来吃饭。别跟她客气。你越是客气，她越是得寸进尺。”
“姐，你知道我的脾气，我不耐烦应酬。下次，下次我一定留下来。姐，你先别忙活，你看这是什么，弟弟我如今有钱，特意给你置办的。”
陈观楼拿出置办的金首饰，嘚瑟的笑。
“天啦！”陈小兰见到这一堆首饰，顿时又急又气。她先是朝门外张望，确定婆母和妯娌没有偷看，然后赶紧关上门窗，压低嗓门，“你哪来的钱？你干什么呢？你可不能乱来啊！”
“姐，这些钱来路光明正大，你不用担心我。天牢每个月除了固定的薪水，还有奖金。奖金才是大头。我一个人生活，又没什么开销，几个月下来攒了点钱，想着大姐身上连一件像样的首饰都没有，就替你置办一套。”
陈小兰听完他的解释，这才放心下来。只要钱来路正就行。
看着金晃晃的首饰，她又是高兴又是心酸。摸着自己光溜溜的脖颈，手腕，苦笑一声，“你送我这些，我也戴不出去。我穿金戴银，婆母一件像样首饰都没有，光是邻里的口水都能淹死我。这些首饰，在我手里怕是保不住。”
“难不成苏老婆子还敢抢儿媳妇娘家送的首饰不成？”陈观楼眼一瞪，一副凶样。
陈小兰叹息一声，“抢倒是不会抢，就是话里话外，能将人磋磨死。”
陈观楼气愤不已，“她要想戴，找苏大诚要去，凭什么盯着儿媳妇的私房。姐，你别怕，大胆的戴。”
“不了。不能给自己找麻烦，更不能给你找麻烦。这些首饰你都拿回去，以后权当聘礼。”

“不行！这是送给你的，哪有拿回去的道理。大不了你收藏起来，拿来压箱底。姐夫两兄弟迟早要分家。再说了，大姐，你手头上也需要攒一点私房。你养我这么多年，现在轮到弟弟我给你撑腰，你别怕。”
陈小兰露出一个心满意足的笑，“有你这番话，这些年的苦没白吃。行，我听你的，首饰用来压箱底。”
“等一等！”
见陈小兰将首饰收捡起来，陈观楼突然想起一件事。
“以防万一，每件首饰我都打上特殊印记。”
陈小兰明显愣住，“这……”她本想说弟弟小人之心。可是转念一想，弟弟这么做也是为了她着想，怕她在苏家为难，担心发生难堪的场面，提前做个准备。无论如何，她也不能说弟弟做错了。
陈观楼拿出随身携带的匕首，细心在首饰背面划出一道“√”模样有点像耐克的商标。这是独属于大姐的首饰标记。
content_en:
On the way home, I made a special trip to the bookstore and bought a few books according to the book list issued by Su Fuzi, spending thirteen taels of silver.
These days, books are too expensive, and reading is too expensive, even a luxury.
At that time, the eldest sister Chen Xiaolan was struggling to make a living in her husband's family and insisted on sending him to a private school. She felt so sad and grievance that it is difficult to express. Once again I realized how much I owed my eldest sister.
He simply bought another set of jewelry, gold earrings, gold bracelets, gold necklaces, and gold rings. In addition, I bought a few kilograms of pig head meat and went to Su's house with a jug of wine.
The food and wine were given to Mrs. Su.
Mrs. Su's originally elongated face had a rare smile, and she even stayed with him for dinner.
He definitely won't eat it.
If he eats dinner, Mrs. Su will have to nag her for several days, and the eldest sister will not be able to relax.
Chen Xiaolan disagreed.
The two siblings talked privately, "The wine and food you bought should be stayed for dinner. Don't be polite to her. The more polite you are, the more she will push her further."
"Sister, you know my temper. I can't bear to socialize. Next time, next time I will definitely stay. Sister, please stop working. Look at what this is. Brother, I have money now, so I bought it specially for you."
Chen Guanlou took out the gold jewelry he bought and smiled coquettishly.
"Oh my god!" Chen Xiaolan was anxious and angry when she saw this pile of jewelry. She first looked out the door to make sure that her mother-in-law and sister-in-law were not peeking, then she quickly closed the doors and windows and lowered her voice, "Where did you get the money? What are you doing? You can't mess around!"
"Sister, the money comes from an open source. You don't have to worry about me. In addition to the fixed salary every month, Tianlao also has bonuses. The bonus is the bulk of it. I live alone and have no expenses. I have saved some money in the past few months. I thought that my eldest sister doesn't even have a decent piece of jewelry, so I bought a set for you."
After hearing his explanation, Chen Xiaolan felt relieved. As long as the money comes from the right source.
Looking at the golden jewelry, she felt happy and sad at the same time. Touching his bare neck and wrists, he smiled bitterly, "If you give me these, I can't wear them. I wear gold and silver, and my mother-in-law doesn't have any decent jewelry. Just the saliva from the neighbors can drown me. I'm afraid I can't keep these jewelry in my hands."
"Is it possible that Mrs. Su still dares to steal the jewelry given by her daughter-in-law's family?" Chen Guanlou glared, looking fierce.
Chen Xiaolan sighed, "I don't know how to rob someone, but my words can wear people to death."
Chen Guanlou was furious, "If she wants to wear it, she has to go to Su Dacheng. Why should she be staring at her daughter-in-law's private room? Sister, don't be afraid, wear it boldly."
"No. I can't cause trouble for myself, let alone you. Take all these jewelry back and use them as betrothal gifts in the future."
"No! This is given to you, there is no reason to take it back. At worst, you can keep it and put it in the bottom of the box. The two brothers will separate sooner or later. Besides, eldest sister, you also need to save some money for your private life. You have supported me for so many years, and now it is my turn to support you, brother. Don't be afraid."
Chen Xiaolan showed a satisfied smile and said, "With your words, all these years of hard work are not in vain. Okay, I will listen to you, the jewelry is used to keep the bottom of the box."
"Wait a minute!"
Seeing Chen Xiaolan putting away the jewelry, Chen Guanlou suddenly remembered something.
"I put a special stamp on each piece of jewelry just in case."
Chen Xiaolan was obviously stunned, "This..." She wanted to say that her brother had a villainous heart. But then I thought about it, my brother did this for her own sake. He was afraid that she would be embarrassed in the Su family and that an embarrassing scene would happen, so he made preparations in advance. No matter what, she couldn't say that her brother had done something wrong.
Chen Guanlou took out the dagger he carried with him and carefully drew a "√" on the back of the jewelry, which looked a bit like Nike's trademark. This is a jewelry mark unique to my eldest sister.
